a wooden nautical instrument
a wooden nautical instrument, about which Hesychius says στρέβλαι ναυτικαί [nautical stréblai]: the timbers of ships, in which they are wedged when fastened.

where Hermann says: "It could have happened that στρέβλαι στρέβλαι ναυτικαί [nautical stréblai] were called timbers, by which, placed crosswise, the ribs and sides of the ship were wedged apart and at the same time, fastened with nails, were drawn together, so that they could neither be pressed inward nor move apart."
